svg.text: Saxl: the tensor square of the staircase contains every irrep
cell = g(ρ, ρ, μ) for one partition μ; reverse-lex order (a linear extension of dominance), read left to right, top to bottom
how many irreps of S_n have a universal tensor square?
bar height = share of irreps whose square contains every irrep; dark = none at all (n = 2, 4, 9)
